title: See it on you
brief: Try your own clothes on before you wear them. For US 18–34s who plan outfits in their head. Studio's try-on redrawn as motion (decisions/0014) in the header's world: on the drop a black tee falls onto her walk-to-work photo and the photo changes, she's wearing it; the pan to Studio, her photo over her wardrobe tray; tap the tee, tap the jeans, each flies onto her; Try it on; the photo sweeps to her in them; both try-ons side by side, "Every look, on you."; the lockup, "Try on your own closet."
hook: 0–1.6 s: her walk-to-work photo; on the drop a black tee falls onto her and the photo sweeps to her wearing it; "See it on you."
components: motion/Designed (Ground, Card, Garment, Pill, Print, Wipe, Pan, MarkWord)
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated: turn on the platform AI label.
The try-ons are AI-generated (Studio's try-on: her photo with the pieces on); the walk-to-work try-on is a draft asset that waits on the founder's approval.
The app is redrawn for the ad (decisions/0014): Studio's wardrobe tray and Try it on as the app shows them, stylised.
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (Can't Get You Off My Mind, Michael Ramir C.): online and social ads are fine; no TV/radio, never register it with Content ID.
